name: Token Pulse
description: Real-time token usage, generation TPS, live model cost, and 5h/weekly quota gauges across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and Antigravity. Reads local agent transcripts and Orca metadata; sends only public pricing requests.

commands.title: Token Pulse: Refresh Usage & Live Pricing

settings.title: Live pricing sync interval (hours)
settings.description: How often to fetch updated official model input/output/cache pricing online.

settings.title: Live transcript refresh interval (seconds)
settings.description: How often to tail active agent transcripts for live token and TPS updates.

settings.title: Daily spend warning threshold (USD, 0 = off)
settings.description: Highlight the status bar in danger tone when today's estimated spend reaches this USD amount.

settings.title: Quota warning threshold (%, 0 = off)
settings.description: Highlight the status bar in warning/danger tone when any provider 5h or weekly quota reaches this percentage.

settings.title: Track Claude Code
settings.description: When off, stops reading Claude Code transcripts and settings, clears its cached sessions, and hides it from the UI and Quotas. Shared Orca account list calls discard Claude Code data and are skipped once all quota providers are off.

settings.title: Track Codex
settings.description: When off, stops reading Codex transcripts and settings, clears its cached sessions, and hides it from the UI and Quotas. Shared Orca account list calls discard Codex data and are skipped once all quota providers are off.

settings.title: Track Antigravity
settings.description: When off, stops reading Antigravity transcripts and settings, clears its cached sessions, and hides it from the UI and Quotas. Shared Orca account list calls discard Antigravity data and are skipped once all quota providers are off.

settings.title: Track Gemini CLI
settings.description: When off, stops reading Gemini CLI transcripts and settings, clears its cached sessions, and hides it from the UI.
